title: Console data client
responsibility: Loads and caches requested console JSON resources.

inputs.name: harnessClient.base
inputs.description: Console mount prefix used to build each `${base}/data/${path}` request URL. It is also the key for sharing default-fetch clients, with no normalization.

inputs.name: harnessClient.fetcher
inputs.description: Optional fetch implementation used for resource requests; when omitted, the code uses the global fetch function via fetcher ?? fetch. Providing a fetcher skips the shared-client cache, so each call to harnessClient creates an independent client.

outputs.name: harnessClient
outputs.description: Client whose index, revision, side, and activity methods fetch their corresponding JSON resources only when called. Default-fetch clients are shared by the exact base string and cache each path's pending or fulfilled promise; rejected loads are evicted for retry, while clients built with an injected fetcher are independent.

errors.name: HarnessDataLoadError
errors.description: An HTTP response with ok === false causes the requested resource promise to reject with an Error whose message includes the data path and status. Rejections from the fetcher and response.json() propagate without wrapping, and failed path promises are removed from the cache for a later retry.
